register_deepspeed_optimizers: register DeepSpeed optimizers like FusedAdam and FusedLamb to the OPTIMIZERS registry
DeepSpeedOptimWrapper: create a DeepSpeedOptimWrapper to handle backward pass and parameter updates via the DeepSpeed engine
MMDeepSpeedEngineWrapper_train_step: run a training step with the MMDeepSpeedEngineWrapper that preprocesses data and updates model parameters
MMDeepSpeedEngineWrapper_val_step: run a validation step with the MMDeepSpeedEngineWrapper to get model predictions on sampled data
DeepSpeedStrategy: build a DeepSpeedStrategy to train models with ZeRO optimization, FP16, and gradient accumulation settings
